color="#ff00ff"> n = len(A)</font></div><div style="line-height: 230%;">&nbsp; <font color="#009900">&nbsp; result = [[0] * n for _ in range(n)]</font></div><div style="line-height: 230%;">&nbsp; &nbsp; for i in range(n):</div><div style="line-height: 230%;">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; for j in range(n):</div><div style="line-height: 230%;">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; for k in range(n):</div><div style="line-height: 230%;">&nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; &nbsp; result[i][j] += A[i][k] * B[k][j]</div><div style="line-height: 230%;">&nbsp; &nbsp; return
